text: 1、市场全天缩量调整，三大指数集体下挫。军工板块逆势活跃，长城军工2连板，中光防雷、建设工业等涨停。半导体芯片股盘中拉升，托伦斯4天3板，至纯科技、博通集成等涨停。下跌方面，电力股集体调整，京能电力、深南电A、粤电力A、大唐发电等多股跌停。个股呈现普跌态势，沪深京三市近5000股飘绿，今日成交1.94万亿，自2026年4月7日以来首次跌破2万亿。截止收盘沪指跌1.61%，深成指跌2.47%，创业板指跌2.65%。 2、板块概念方面，仅电子特气、高带宽存储等少数板块飘红，贵金属、电力、煤炭、医药等板块跌幅居前。 3、两市共534只个股上涨，42只个股涨停，
text_en: 1. The market generally adjusted with shrinking volume, and all three major indices fell sharply. The defense sector was actively moving against the trend, with Great Wall Defense hitting its 2nd consecutive daily limit up. Companies like ARCTIC WOLF (Zhongguang Fanglei) and Jianshe Industrial also hit their daily limits up. The semiconductor chip sector picked up intraday, with Torrence hitting its 4th daily limit up in 5 days, and Zhichun Technology and Beiling Jicheng also hitting daily limits up. On the downside, the entire power sector corrected, with multiple stocks like Jingneng Electric Power, Shenzhen Nandian A, Yuedian Power A, and Datang Power hitting daily limits down. Stocks broadly declined, with nearly 5,000 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets falling. Today's turnover was 1.94 trillion yuan, falling below 2 trillion for the first time since April 7, 2026. At the close, the Shanghai Composite fell 1.61%, the Shenzhen Component fell 2.47%, and the ChiNext fell 2.65%. 2. By sector concept, only a few sectors like Electronic Specialty Gas and HBM were in the green, while sectors like Precious Metals, Electric Power, Coal, and Pharmaceuticals fell the most. 3. A total of 534 stocks across the two cities rose, with 42 stocks hitting their daily limits up.
